content.text: The vendor sheet is out of date. It was last reviewed 2026-09-14 and still shows the old Monday/Thursday route (vendors.csv SITE-01 V1 rev1). Maya's note says the Alder rep confirmed the route changed on Sept 28 to Monday/Wednesday, with orders due by noon the day before (notes.csv SITE-01 N09 rev1). The ledger planning belief follows that note, not the sheet (vendor.V1.delivery_days from note:N09). The sheet hasn't been corrected, so it still shows Thursday. The rep's confirmation is relayed in Maya's note and isn't a supplier document, so a quick check with Alder would settle it. I can't tell from my tools whether the restaurant has anything from Alder in writing.
